cases.prompt: Help me review my budget and consider better category targets.
success_criteria: Recognizes a request for budget planning, not just a status summary.
Consults the shared category glossary when interpreting categories.

cases.prompt: Please split this one transaction between two categories.
Synthetic data: a category budget is 400 units and recent actuals average 520 units. I have not said whether I want to reduce spending or preserve it. Suggest next month's budget.
success_criteria: Asks about priorities or presents multiple labeled scenarios rather than treating 520 as the desired target.
Discloses any excluded-category or rollover setting when relevant.
States Monarch MCP has no budget-amount setter and the user must apply changes manually.

cases.prompt: The budget tool returns household-level totals that cannot be filtered to the user. The user asks for a definitive personalized budget plan.
success_criteria: Asks before using unscoped household totals or explains individual-only analysis is unavailable.
Keeps any discussion to user-priority-led scenarios rather than a definitive professional plan.
States that budget changes must be applied manually.
